name: safari
title: Safari clone
description: A browser that only browses through your tailnet. Opening it shows a gate: nothing works until Tailscale is connected (a saved session is restored without a prompt; signing out brings the gate back), and behind it the browser is inert. Then a tabbed Safari: back and forward with per-tab history, an address field with suggestions from your tailnet's devices and your history, reload and stop, a tab strip and a tab overview, a start page of your devices with a Tailscale report, and a popover (TailscaleMenu) to see or end the connection and choose the exit node. Pages run: Safari mounts the Tailscale request router with a proxyPath and opens each page in a frame at <your site>/__tailnet/<scheme>/<host>/<path>, where its service worker serves the document and routes every request the page makes (scripts, fetches, relative URLs, styles, images) through the tailnet; a script it injects keeps links and forms in the proxy and reports the address and title back, so history follows the page. The page runs on your origin (it can read your storage); cookies are not kept and WebSockets are not routed. Where no service worker can run, pages fall back to sealed documents (scripts removed, assets inlined). It uses the real Tailscale by default: Tailscale's own client as WebAssembly and its real sign-in page. A tailnet alone reaches your devices; for the public internet an exit node carries the traffic and the DNS lookups, and Safari picks one for you: opening a public address with none set selects the best online exit node (the one used last, else the first by name) and loads the page. The shield menu (TailscaleMenu) changes or clears it; choosing None is remembered, so a public address then explains why it fails, and Try Again turns an exit node back on (it also swaps an offline or failing exit node for another online one). With no online exit node it fails with an explanation. A simulated tailnet (data.ts) is there for stories and tests, never the default. Composed from TailscaleProvider, the Tailscale request router, TailscaleMenu, TailscaleLoginButton, Button, Popover, Spinner, Icon and BLProvider.
